title: Checks From the Corner
setup: White's f-pawn is a move from queening, and its rook on c7 is hanging to the black king on b6.
hint: You need a spare move to take on c7. Which file gives checks the white king cannot simply walk away from?
explanation:
## The Idea

Black needs one tempo, and only distant checks buy it. {{Rh1+}} {{Kg6}} {{Rg1+}} {{Kf5}}, and now {{Kxc7}} wins the rook. White queens, but {{Rf1+}} skewers the king to the new queen and takes it straight back. Go behind the pawn at once with {{Rf1}} instead, and White answers {{Re7}}, defending everything, and the pawn goes in.
